design: Each pick compared against a random legal window from the same episode: same length rules, same real beat boundaries, not selected. The judge sees two clips as plain text, never a score and never which is which. Every pair was judged twice, once in each presentation order, so position bias cancels by construction rather than by correction.
unit_of_analysis: The pair, not the judgement. The two judgements of a pair concern the same two clips and are not independent, so the binomial test runs on pairs that gave the same answer in both orders. Pairs that flipped with order carry no signal about content.
